_comment: B-007. D4 of /code-quality reads this file's EXISTENCE to decide whether mutation testing is configured (detectors/_mutation.py:200), and reads reports/mutation/mutation.json for the score — never the exit code, because a runner that collected nothing still exits 0.
_comment_runner: The `command` runner rather than a framework adapter: the suite is `node --test`, and adopting Vitest to get a first-class adapter would rewrite 1339 lines of working tests to satisfy a tool that already handles this case (ADR-1).
_comment_scope: 480 lines, the installer and its three modules — the product. `skills/` is Markdown with nothing to mutate, and mutating `tests/` measures only that an assertion changed (ADR-2).
_comment_thresholds: Mirrors code-quality-golden-rule.md § 2: below 60 caps the audit at 70, 60-79 caps at 89. `break` is null on purpose — this run exists to produce a number, and failing the command on a low score would hide the survivors that are the finding (ADR-3).
